answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 41054 Country: India Title: Islamic Names Question: We are expecting a baby by this week end and I have selected a male baby name as Masoodh Abdullah and girl baby's name as Hana Manha. Please give me the correct spelling and meaning for these names. Also give me the details of aqiqah and the other sunnah that has to be done on the 7th day of the child birth. Answer ID: 41054 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1431/911/L=1433) It is correct to keep the name ‘Masood Abdullah’ in case it is a boy. It means blessed and fortunate. It is also right to keep the name ’Hena’ in case it is a girl. It means Henna. But its next part Manha is meaningless hence you should not keep it as name. If you keep any other name amongst the following names then it shall be far better: Ayesha, Hafsa, Ruqayya, Kulsum, Fatima, Juveriya, Khansa etc. It is mustahab to name the child on the seventh day of its birth, to shave its head, and give gold or silver equal to its hair in charity as well as do aqiqah of two goats in case it is a boy and one goat in case it is a girl. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
